newsitem.title: USA: Red Roof Inns to expand credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Red Roof Inns to expand credit facility.

text.p: Red Roof Inns Inc on Thursday said it expanded its credit facility to $250 million from $150 million.
The company, which operates economy hotels, said CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp and Huntington National Bank would act as its agents.

The bank group includes CIBC Inc, Huntington National Bank, Bank One, PNC Bank Corp, Banque Nationale de Paris, Harris Trust and Savings Bank, NBD Bank, Bank of Scotland, Fifth Third Bank of Columbus, Mitsui Leasing (USA) Inc, Norwest Bank Minnesota NA, Star Bank NA and Suntrust Bank.

Francis Cash, Red Roof's chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer, said "This credit facility gives us additional financial flexibility to continue to pursue our strategic growth objectives."
Red Roof Inns is an economy lodging chain which is pursuing a growth strategy that includes internal development as well as franchising.
